why_this_model: The decision combines live runtime proof, financial extraction isolation, GitHub publication, and canonical merge authority.
worker_decision_limit: No worker may authorize push, merge, runtime mutation, or financial-truth changes.
lower_tier_insufficient_reason: A merge decision requires exact-head, runtime, provenance, repository, and owner-boundary adjudication.
duplicate_work_decision: Proceed with the existing integration branch; do not create a parallel implementation.
remaining_blocker: none for the approved routing scope
minority_objection: The GPU-exclusive proof used the real shared activity token rather than a real extraction, and the UI on port 8081 remains absent. Merge must not be described as full extraction-throughput or UI proof.
root_problem: Interactive and non-metric LLM work could contend with metric extraction for the shared local llama router.
overfitting: No; the fix applies to the route class across keyword chat and non-metric JSON work.
report_loop: No; the lane advanced through code, controlled activation, intended-output proof, and merge approval.
broad_progress: Yes; the routing boundary, model default, provenance, launcher portability, tests, and live runtime were aligned.
class_based_approach: Route-class separation is preferable to request-specific or ticker-specific handling.
production_readiness_value: Canonicalizing the functionally proven branch removes dependence on an unpushed local live worktree.
approved_actions: mark ready and merge after required checks pass
